categories.main_business_segments: ResMed operates in two primary business segments: Sleep and Respiratory Care, which includes devices, masks, accessories, and diagnostic products for sleep apnea, COPD, and other respiratory disorders; and Software as a Service (SaaS), which provides cloud-based software solutions for out-of-hospital healthcare providers such as home medical equipment (HME) companies, home health, hospice, skilled nursing, and senior living facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include cloud-connected CPAP, APAP, bilevel, and ventilation devices, advanced mask systems, and digital health platforms for remote monitoring and patient engagement. Manufacturing is globally distributed, with facilities in the US, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, China, and France, focusing on quality, cost control, and supply chain resilience. SaaS offerings are developed through acquisitions and in-house R&D, leveraging secure cloud infrastructure and interoperability standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ResMed’s primary customers are home healthcare dealers, sleep clinics, hospitals, and out-of-hospital care providers, including HME, home health, hospice, skilled nursing, and senior living organizations. The end markets are patients with sleep apnea, COPD, neuromuscular diseases, and other chronic respiratory conditions, as well as healthcare professionals and caregivers managing these populations.
categories.geographic_coverage: ResMed sells products in over 140 countries, with significant operations and sales in the United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. The company has wholly owned subsidiaries and direct sales operations in major markets, and also operates home healthcare businesses in Germany, Australia, New Zealand, and South Korea. SaaS products are primarily sold in the US and Germany.
categories.supply_chain_position: ResMed operates primarily in the downstream segment of the healthcare supply chain, manufacturing finished medical devices and software solutions that are distributed to healthcare providers and end-users. The company also provides vertically integrated services in select markets, directly supplying products and care to patients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include ongoing innovation in sleep apnea and respiratory care devices, expansion of digital health and cloud-based platforms, and growth of SaaS solutions for out-of-hospital care. R&D efforts focus on improving patient outcomes, enhancing device connectivity, expanding remote monitoring and engagement tools, and developing new clinical applications. Approximately 19% of employees are dedicated to R&D, and the company actively pursues acquisitions to complement organic innovation.
categories.revenue_model: ResMed generates revenue primarily through the sale of medical devices (CPAP, APAP, ventilators), masks, accessories, and diagnostic products, as well as recurring revenue from SaaS subscriptions and software licensing. Additional revenue streams include extended warranties, service contracts, and direct-to-patient sales in select markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in Sleep and Respiratory Care include Philips BV, Fisher & Paykel Healthcare, DeVilbiss Healthcare, Apex Medical, BMC Medical, React Health, and Lowenstein, as well as regional and new-entrant manufacturers. In SaaS, competition is intense and includes in-house systems and other healthcare IT providers. ResMed is a global leader in digital health and cloud-connected respiratory care, with a strong market position and broad geographic reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024, ResMed reported net revenue of $4.7 billion, up 11% from the prior year, with net income of $1.0 billion and a gross margin of 56.7%. The company has nearly 10,000 employees, strong operating cash flow ($1.4 billion in FY24), and a history of consistent growth driven by both organic expansion and acquisitions. SaaS revenue grew 17% year-over-year, and the company maintains a robust balance sheet with $6.9 billion in total assets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ResMed differentiates itself through integrated digital health solutions that combine cloud-connected devices, advanced patient engagement tools, and comprehensive SaaS platforms for out-of-hospital care. The company emphasizes improved patient outcomes, enhanced therapy adherence, operational efficiencies for providers, and reduced healthcare costs. Its global scale, innovation track record, and focus on connected care position it as a leader in transforming chronic disease management outside the hospital.
